2. The present appeal has been filed:
against the impugned Judgement and order dated 10/02/2025 and 13/02/2025 passed in S. Trial No.-309/2021, arising out of Bathnaha P.S. case no. 114/2021,
passed by the District and Additional Sessions Judge IV Cum Exclusive Special Judge (Rape & POCSO), Sitamarhi whereby and whereunder Appellant has been held guilty u/s 376 IPC and ultimately sentenced to undergo rigorous imprisonment for eight (08) years along with fine of Rs. 10,000/-
(Ten thousand rupees).
In default of payment of fine, convict will undergo further simple imprisonment of six (06) months.
